newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING Barings sees Dutch lifting official rates.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings sees Dutch lifting official rates.

text.p: IN Barings on Wednesday became the second Dutch bank in less than a week to forecast a possible increase in official Dutch interest rates.
In a research note, INB Barings said the Dutch central bank might raise the special advances rate to 3.00 percent from 2.90 percent in the near future.
It cited the recent weakness of the guilder against the German mark and the fact that Germany's equivalent rate, the repo, was at 3.00 percent.
On Monday, Rabobank International said it was a matter of time before the advances rate was lifted to 3.00 percent.
ING Barings said: "The impact on the German/Dutch long-term interest rate spread will be very small. As the (European economic and monetary union) approaches, this spread will decrease to zero."
